dialogue.content: （こんばんわ　今日はどうぞよろしくお願いいたします。お時間までお待ちしましょうか？）
dialogue.English: (Good evening. Thank you for coming today. Shall we wait until our scheduled time?)

dialogue.content: こんばんは出来ましたら、時間までお待ちいただけないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Good evening. If possible, could you please wait until the scheduled time?

dialogue.content: （承知しました　それでは２１時になりましたら始めさせていただきます。）
dialogue.English: (Understood. In that case, we'll begin at 9:00 PM.)

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございます）
dialogue.English: (Thank you.)

dialogue.content: （では　２１時なりましたので始めさせていただいていいでしょうか？）
dialogue.English: (Well then, it's 9:00 PM now, so shall we begin?)

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました。お願いします）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for waiting. Yes, please.)

dialogue.content: こんばんわ　本日相談員をさせていただきます　よろしくお願い致します。　まず初めに　年齢、性別　またあなたを何さんとお呼びしたら良いでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'll be your counselor today. It's a pleasure to meet you. First, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like me to call you?

dialogue.content: 38才、あいです。女です
dialogue.English: I'm 38, my name is Ai, and I'm a woman.

dialogue.content: 答えていただきありがとうございました。本日のご相談の内容をお聞きしていいですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that with me. May I ask what you would like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 離婚をしたいと思ってますが、いろいろ不安で…
dialogue.English: I'm thinking about getting a divorce, but I'm worried about so many things...

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね　離婚となると問題もいろいろと出てきて不安になるのは当然です。今までの事を少しお話していただけますか？
dialogue.English: I see. It's completely natural to feel anxious, as divorce brings up many different issues. Could you tell me a little about what has been happening?

dialogue.content: もう、どこから話していいのか。。
dialogue.English: I don't even know where to start...

dialogue.content: そうですよね　いつ頃から離婚を考えているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: That's understandable. Around when did you start thinking about divorce?

dialogue.content: 最初は、上の子をちょっと身ごもっている時に、ダンナから暴力を振るわれて…
dialogue.English: It started when I was pregnant with my older child; my husband was violent with me...

dialogue.content: 上の子を身ごもっている時、です
dialogue.English: When I was pregnant with my older child, I mean.

dialogue.content: 妊娠中に・・・！　それは酷いですねはい　大丈夫ですよ　原因はどんな事だったのでしょうか
dialogue.English: During your pregnancy...! That's terrible. It's okay. Could you tell me what triggered it?

dialogue.content: ささいな喧嘩からでした
dialogue.English: It started from a trivial argument.

dialogue.content: こっちも妊娠中だったからホルモンバランスも良くない状態で、
dialogue.English: I was pregnant at the time, so my hormones were out of balance,

dialogue.content: ささいな事で暴力に・・・身ごもっている時は逆に優しく対応してもらえるものだと思いますが。そうですね女性特有のバランスが崩れますよね
dialogue.English: It escalated to violence over something trivial... I would think that's a time he would treat you with more kindness. Yes, that hormonal balance unique to women can be disrupted.

dialogue.content: 口喧嘩から、旦那は物を私に向けて投げてきたり、私を蹴ってきたりしました
dialogue.English: It went from a verbal argument to my husband throwing things at me and kicking me.

dialogue.content: それで、怖くて携帯だけ持ってトイレににげました
dialogue.English: I was so scared that I grabbed only my phone and ran to the bathroom to hide.

dialogue.content: 身重な状態で　その時はお怪我はなかったのですか？
dialogue.English: While you were pregnant... Were you injured at that time?

dialogue.content: はい　聴いていますね
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm listening.

dialogue.content: ありました。目を蹴られて、パンパンに腫れました。
dialogue.English: Yes. He kicked me in the eye, and it swelled up badly.

dialogue.content: わぁ　酷い　そんな状態で
dialogue.English: Oh my—that's awful, especially in that condition.

dialogue.content: トイレから携帯で姉に電話して、泣き叫んで迎えに来てもらいました。
dialogue.English: From the bathroom, I called my older sister on my phone, crying and screaming, and asked her to come get me.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか・・妹さん　すぐに来られましたか？
dialogue.English: I see... Did your younger sister come right away?

dialogue.content: 姉です
dialogue.English: My older sister.

dialogue.content: すみません　間違いました
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, my mistake.

dialogue.content: 姉は相当驚いて、タクシーで来ました
dialogue.English: My sister was completely shocked and came in a taxi.

dialogue.content: 妹さんも　びっくりされましたよね
dialogue.English: Your younger sister must have been shocked as well.

dialogue.content: 姉です
dialogue.English: My older sister.

dialogue.content: すみません　何度も間違えて
dialogue.English: I'm so sorry for getting that wrong again.

dialogue.content: 大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: It's okay.

dialogue.content: とりあえず、その時は眼科にまず行って検査しました
dialogue.English: Anyway, at that time, I first went to an eye doctor to get it checked.

dialogue.content: 心配でしたよね
dialogue.English: You must have been worried.

dialogue.content: コンタクトをしていたので。そのあとは姉の家に行き、両親を呼び事の経緯を話しました
dialogue.English: I was wearing contact lenses. After that, I went to my sister's house, we called our parents over, and I explained what happened.

dialogue.content: 家族で問題の対応に当たったのですね
dialogue.English: So your family handled the situation together.

dialogue.content: ウチの家族は離婚した方が良い、って話になりましたが、私は子供がこれから産まれてくるのに、経済的にやっていけるか不安でしたし、
dialogue.English: My family said I should get a divorce, but with a baby on the way, I was worried about whether I could manage financially, and...

dialogue.content: まだ、その頃は旦那も子供が産まれたら変わってくれると思ってました
dialogue.English: Back then, I still thought my husband would change once the baby was born.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 一時的な事だと思ってしまいますよね・・・ご自身の子供さんが生まれたら　愛情をもって貰えると思います
dialogue.English: It's easy to think it's just a temporary thing... You'd think he would become more loving once his own child is born.

dialogue.content: 子供には暴力はしないんです。むしろ可愛がっているんでさ
dialogue.English: He isn't violent towards the children. In fact, he dotes on them.

dialogue.content: です
dialogue.English: He is.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか　それは良い事ですね
dialogue.English: I see. That's a good thing.

dialogue.content: その後は暴力はないけど、数年後からお金をきちんと渡してくれなくなったんです
dialogue.English: The violence stopped after that, but a few years later he stopped giving me money properly.

dialogue.content: そんな事がおこったのですね　それは又大きな不安ですね
dialogue.English: I see—that must be another major source of anxiety.

dialogue.content: うちは、旦那の両親も同居なので生活費が結構かかるのに。
dialogue.English: We live with my husband's parents too, so our living expenses are quite high.

dialogue.content: ちなみに同居されているご両親の生活費も面倒をみているということでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Just to clarify, are you also looking after the living expenses of his parents who live with you?

dialogue.content: そうなんです。光熱費は両親が払ってくれてますが、その他食費などの生活費はこっちで面倒みてます。これが結構大変なんです
dialogue.English: That's right. His parents pay for the utilities, but we take care of other living expenses like food. It's quite a struggle.

dialogue.content: 今ご家族は何名いらっしゃるの？
dialogue.English: How many people are in your household now?

dialogue.content: 私を含めて6人です
dialogue.English: Six, including me.

dialogue.content: ではお子さんがお二人ということですね？何歳になられましたか？
dialogue.English: So you have two children, is that right? How old are they now?

dialogue.content: 子供の習い事とかまで支払うと、月15万くらいかかります
dialogue.English: Including the kids' lessons and such, it costs about 150,000 yen a month.

dialogue.content: 上は小4、下は小1
dialogue.English: The older one is in 4th grade, the younger in 1st grade.

dialogue.content: １５万はかかりますよね　それなのに　夫さんはどういう理由で資金を入れないのか　理由はお聴きできましたか？
dialogue.English: Yes, 150,000 yen is a significant amount. And despite that, have you been able to ask your husband why he doesn't contribute money?

dialogue.content: 昔から、外で飲み食いで使ってます。毎晩のように。
dialogue.English: He's always spent it on eating and drinking out. Almost every night.

dialogue.content: そんな状態で毎日あいさんは家族のために必死で家事をしているなんて　とても耐えられない状態だと思います
dialogue.English: It must be an unbearable situation for you, Ai, working so hard every day for the family under these circumstances.

dialogue.content: そうなんです。もう別れたい。
dialogue.English: Exactly. I want to leave him.

dialogue.content: 一旦、今までのお話をまとめてもいいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Would it be okay if I took a moment to summarize what you've told me so far?

dialogue.content: お願いします
dialogue.English: Please do.

dialogue.content: 現在６人のご家族の生活を支えているあいさん　妊娠当初に夫の暴力でご自身の家族に相談をし、一度は家族が別れた方がいいのでは？という案があったけれど、
dialogue.English: You're currently supporting a family of six, Ai. Early in your pregnancy, you experienced violence from your husband and consulted your own family. They suggested it might be better to separate, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それでも我慢をしおよそ１０年間も夫婦生活をしていたのだが、夫さんのご両親も世話をしているのも関わらず　生活費も入れてくれない夫さん
dialogue.English: ...you endured it and have continued the marriage for about ten years. However, despite you also caring for his parents, your husband doesn't provide money for living expenses.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 子供の事はかわいがってはくれるが、自分は毎晩　外で飲みに行き生活する資金もなくなる不安で、あいさんは今離婚を考えている
dialogue.English: He does dote on the children, but he goes out drinking every night, and you're worried about running out of money to live on. Because of this, you are now considering divorce.

dialogue.content: ということでお間違いないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is that a correct summary?

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: とても考えられないような生活だと思いますが、今問題とされているのは生活資金の事だけでしょうか？
dialogue.English: It sounds like a very difficult situation. Is the main issue now the household finances, or are there other concerns as well?

dialogue.content: ただ離婚の話が出ると、子供は置いていけ、と。お前だけが文句ばかり言うと。気に入らんなら、お前だけが出ていけば済む事だと。
dialogue.English: But when the topic of divorce comes up, he says, 'Leave the children here. You're the only one complaining. If you don't like it, you can just leave by yourself.'

dialogue.content: そんな事を・・それを聞いてあいさんはどのように答えたのですか？
dialogue.English: He says that...? How did you respond when you heard that, Ai?

dialogue.content: 何も言えないです
dialogue.English: I can't say anything.

dialogue.content: 確かに、私だけなら経済的にも何とかなるだろうけど、まだ小さい子供を置いていくなんて。
dialogue.English: It's true that if it were just me, I could probably manage financially, but to leave my young children behind...

dialogue.content: でも子供を連れて行くとなると、経済的にやっていける不安で。
dialogue.English: But if I were to take the children with me, I'm worried about whether I could support us financially.

dialogue.content: 子供さんを手はなすなんて母親としては耐えられない事だとおもいますが、実際に離婚となると、それは覚悟ができない感じなのでしょうか
dialogue.English: As a mother, letting go of your children must be unbearable. When you think about actually getting a divorce, does it feel like something you can't bring yourself to do?

dialogue.content: そうですね。おそらく今後、子供たちには会わせてくれないと思います。
dialogue.English: That's right. I'm sure he wouldn't let me see the children in the future.

dialogue.content: 子供のためだけに、頑張ってきたのに！
dialogue.English: And I've been enduring all this just for the sake of my children!

dialogue.content: そうですよね　とても辛い事だと思います。今後の事、ご心配があると思いますので、これから一緒に考えていけたらいいかと思います
dialogue.English: I understand. That must be very painful. I know you have concerns about the future, so I hope we can think about it together from now on.

dialogue.content: お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: 今までお話をお聴きして　あいさんは夫さんの暴力　ご両親との同居　子育て　生活費の不安を抱えながら　この数年間よく耐えてこられたと思います。
dialogue.English: Listening to your story, Ai, I think you've endured so much over these past several years, dealing with your husband's violence, living with his parents, raising children, and worrying about finances.

dialogue.content: そう言っていただけると。
dialogue.English: It helps to hear you say that.

dialogue.content: 子供さんがいたからとのことですが、あいさんの愛情が深いから　ここまでこれたのだと私は思いました。
dialogue.English: You said it was because of your children, but I believe you've come this far because of your deep love, Ai.

dialogue.content: そうですかね。子供しかないので。
dialogue.English: Do you think so? My children are all I have.

dialogue.content: そんな夫さん　とっとと別れて当然だと思いますが、子供と別れることが不安で決心できない、経済的な不安との事ですが、
dialogue.English: With a husband like that, it would be natural to want to leave him immediately. But you're saying you can't make the decision because you're afraid of being separated from your children and have financial worries.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: まずは　あいさんのその不安を取り除く事から始めてみてはいかがでしょうか
dialogue.English: How about we start by trying to alleviate some of your anxieties, Ai?

dialogue.content: と、言いますと？
dialogue.English: What do you mean by that?

dialogue.content: ご両親に相談をして、実家に帰ることを考えてみるとか、
dialogue.English: For example, talking to your parents and considering moving back home,

dialogue.content: それが母と私は昔から合わないので、ムリなんです
dialogue.English: That's not possible. My mother and I have never gotten along.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。では、あいさんのお仕事探しで何かできることは？
dialogue.English: I see. Well then, is there anything you can do regarding finding a job for yourself, Ai?

dialogue.content: 今はパートです。子供がもう少し大きくなるまでは、家に出来るだけいてあげたいと思って…
dialogue.English: I'm working part-time right now. I want to be at home for my children as much as possible until they're a little older...

dialogue.content: また　お住いの相談窓口を使って母子家庭の援助なども利用できるかと思います。
dialogue.English: Also, you may be able to use the support services in your area to get assistance for single mothers.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: Oh, I see.

dialogue.content: 調べてみます
dialogue.English: I'll look into it.

dialogue.content: 幼い子供を置いておけないと心配ですよね子供を預かってくれる場なども　何かしらでてくる事もあります
dialogue.English: It's natural to worry about not being able to leave your young children. There may be options for childcare that come up.

dialogue.content: まずは　あいさんの健康も大切だと自覚してください
dialogue.English: First and foremost, please recognize that your own well-being is also important, Ai.

dialogue.content: 一度、学童保育にあずけたんですが、うちの子供には合わなかったんで、辞めてしまったんです
dialogue.English: I tried putting my child in after-school care once, but it wasn't a good fit, so we stopped.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: そんな夫さんを頼っても何の解決にもならないと私は思います。
dialogue.English: I don't think relying on a husband like that will solve anything.

dialogue.content: そうなんですよね。わかってます。もう旦那は変わらないって。
dialogue.English: I know. I understand that. My husband isn't going to change.

dialogue.content: 少し頭を冷やすつもりで　出ていくのも一つの方法だと思いますので是非これから一歩進んでみませんか？
dialogue.English: I think leaving, even just to give yourself some space to think clearly, is one option. Would you be willing to take a step forward?

dialogue.content: どうやってですか？
dialogue.English: How would I do that?

dialogue.content: 学童保育が合わないなら又、何か探してみましょう
dialogue.English: If that after-school program didn't work, let's look for something else.

dialogue.content: これから　私も何かしら方法を探してみます。今日はお時間が迫ってきましたので、
dialogue.English: I'll also look into some options for you. Our time is running short for today, so...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 次回まで　ご自身と子供さん２人の生活でどれくらい資金が必要か考えてみてください
dialogue.English: Before our next session, please try to think about how much money you would need to live on with your two children.

dialogue.content: わかりました
dialogue.English: I will.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 母子家庭の給付もあると思いますので　調べてみて、
dialogue.English: There are benefits available for single-mother households, so please look into those,

dialogue.content: 一緒に考えて行きましょう
dialogue.English: and we can think about it together.

dialogue.content: はい、わかりました
dialogue.English: Yes, I will.

dialogue.content: あいさんに幸せになってもらいたいです。
dialogue.English: I want you to be happy, Ai.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 時間オーバーになってしまいましたが、今日はご相談にきてくださってありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: We've gone a little over our time, but thank you for coming to talk with me today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました
dialogue.English: No, thank you.

dialogue.content: また　近い内にご相談にきてくださいねそれでは終了メッセージをおくらせていただきますね
dialogue.English: Please come back for another session soon. I will send the closing message now.

dialogue.content: はい。ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Okay. Thank you very much.
